translations.web: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
translations.bsb: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.
translations.kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
translations.asv: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out demons: freely ye received, freely give.
